en: Black-and-white landscape view over a rocky coastal settlement with scattered wooden houses and villas surrounded by trees and low hills. In the foreground are large bare rocks; in the midground stand several steep-roofed Nordic-style houses, some with small towers or dormers. Utility poles run through the scene. In the far distance are more low islands or coastline and open water. The bottom left corner bears the caption "STYRSÖ." and in the bottom right corner there is a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 3410.
